content:
- name: Verify every source directory has a corresponding test directory
  run: |
    # Locate source files (common extensions) excluding those already under test directories
    src_dirs=$(find . -type f \( -name "*.py" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.java" -o -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.c" -o -name "*.go" -o -name "*.rs" \) \
      ! -path "*/test/*" ! -path "*/tests/*" | xargs -r dirname | sort -u)
    # If no source files found, treat as satisfied
    if [ -z "$src_dirs" ]; then
      exit 0
    fi
    missing=0
    while IFS= read -r dir; do
      if [ ! -d "$dir/test" ]; then
        echo "Error: Source directory '$dir' lacks a 'test' subdirectory."
        missing=1
      fi
    done <<< "$src_dirs"
    if [ $missing -ne 0 ]; then
      exit 1
    fi
    exit 0
